title: melilotus sulcatus subsp. infestus
intro: Melilotus sulcatus subsp. infestus, commonly known as Hoary Melilot, is a plant species in the legume family that is native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help alleviate symptoms of menopausal hot flashes and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hoary Melilot are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to stress and promote relaxation, which may be useful in treating anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, coumarins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
